scope: Exchange maximum stakes, remaining position capacity, wallet-proposal leverage tiers, and strategy exits on the entry candle; all 53 retained X8-named captures plus one X7 regression.
notes: Maximum amount and cost limits are normalized using the frozen market contract size. Null explicitly denotes an unbounded limit; missing/invalid limits fail closed.
The cost limit caps pre-fee notional before amount precision; it does not include exchange fees.
Leverage tiers use the wallet proposal before custom stake sizing. Callback and order bounds use their respective official leverage conventions.
Additional order validation subtracts the existing trade stake from exchange capacity while retaining the real wallet allocation in callback observations.

High leverage exposed an opening-candle doom exit. The successful official export was authenticated and sealed while preserving the original failed parity receipt; the corrected replay is independently verified.
Optional simulator contract fields preserve archived input behavior. Newly compiled exit policies evaluate source exits immediately after entry.
Official direct-helper vectors include combinations that are not admitted full Spot/Futures configurations; full lifecycle scope is limited to the captured cases.
Strategy callbacks, class constants and frozen exchange metadata are unchanged; signal/indicator transformations and configuration overrides are disclosed in sealed recipes.
limitations: Complete configuration support and production certification remain open; broader exchange/order policies and pairlist combinations require additional coverage.
Position stacking, fractional trade slots, forced source/exchange mode mismatches and cross-margin multi-currency collateral remain rejected.
